title: Audit stale KGEN wallet discovery, frozen supply, and external metadata status without issuing wallet requests or publication claims

pr_scope.historical_hold_comment: Owner/dispatcher note requires Draft/HOLD, no merge, distinct review, and an authorized external-submission path.

reason: PR 179 adds user-initiated wallet_switchEthereumChain and wallet_watchAsset requests, a read-only validation workflow, frozen BSC supply observations, public API projections, and external metadata documents. It does not request a transaction or approval and its historical exact-head tests are green, but wallet-provider consent remains an external user action; the supply snapshot is fixed at BSC block 118374207 on 2026-08-27; the narrative contains a different historical block reference; and BscScan or CoinMarketCap submission, acceptance, ownership, authority, and current state are not proven. The branch is 745 commits behind current main and modifies a stale root portal and universal test lineage. The safe bounded action is a current-main lineage audit only, with zero transplant and zero wallet, platform, workflow-dispatch, credential, or chain side effect.

inventory.security_blocker: PR 179 lacks current user-consent UX evidence, current supply evidence, authenticated platform receipts, and repository-bound authority for any wallet or metadata publication action.

blocking_findings: PR 179 is open, Draft, unmerged, non-mergeable, diverged, and 745 commits behind exact current main.
The root portal calls wallet_switchEthereumChain and wallet_watchAsset after a button click. These are user-visible wallet-provider requests and are not exercised by this audit.
The wallet code does not call eth_sendTransaction, eth_sendRawTransaction, approve, or transfer, but absence of transfer authority does not authorize a chain-switch or watch-asset prompt.

The snapshot is frozen at BSC block 118374207 with timestamp 2026-08-27T11:17:35Z; it is historical evidence, not current total supply, circulating supply, holder, owner, reserve, or entitlement state.
The circulating-supply narrative also retains BSC block 118355844 and older July evidence, so the package contains multiple observation vintages that cannot be collapsed into a current claim.
Public owner, creator, bank, reward, auto-LP, pair, contract, and holder addresses do not prove controller, signer, ownership, custody, treasury, employment, Life identity, or Company authority.
The BscScan document explicitly says external publication is not confirmed and records no ownership signature or accepted submission receipt.
The CoinMarketCap package is a read-only historical verification candidate and records no external submission or platform acceptance.

The refresh script calls public RPC and GoPlus endpoints and writes repository projections; it is not run because this audit cannot turn mutable external data into authenticated authority or current Canon.
The historical read-only workflow has contents: read and green exact-head runs, but a branch-specific stale workflow is not transplanted.
The old root index and wallet-discovery test do not have current-main shell, accessibility, consent, real-browser, or screenshot evidence and must not replace current product surfaces.
Historical CI success cannot manufacture current external state, accepted publication, a Human decision, reviewer identity, Company authority, signer control, or Mainnet permission.
safe_successor_requirements: Start from exact current main on a non-codex branch and preserve protected Canon, CURRENT, Boot, contract, wallet, bridge, workflow, and public-site boundaries.
Treat block, supply, holder, owner, reserve, liquidity, listing, verification, and metadata values as timestamped external observations with source URLs and observation times.

Require an explicit user gesture, precise pre-request explanation, rejection recovery, supported-chain handling, accessibility checks, and current-main Chromium screenshot evidence before any wallet-discovery UI can be considered.
Require repository-bound Human authority plus action-time confirmation before any authenticated BscScan, CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, wallet, contract, or listing submission.
Require authenticated external receipts and a post-action public re-read before changing a status to submitted, accepted, verified, listed, or published.

Never infer controller, signer, ownership, custody, treasury, employment, Life identity, or Company authority from a public address, holder index, transaction, explorer page, GitHub authorship, or local file.
Never access credentials, generate ownership signatures, send wallet requests, send transactions, dispatch workflows, call paid APIs, or mutate external or chain state as part of a lineage audit.

exact_current_main.note: The only subsequent main change before this audit was the document-only PR 196 lineage work order.
